question: Should OpenClaw accept per-conversation WhatsApp `debounceMs` under `channels.whatsapp.direct` and `channels.whatsapp.groups` as a supported public config surface?
rationale: The implementation is additive, but repository policy treats new config surfaces as compatibility-sensitive and the PR lacks maintainer-confirmed direction for this extra operator knob.

options.title: Approve with docs and proof
options.body: Accept the surface only after the contributor documents precedence and posts redacted real WhatsApp behavior proof.

options.title: Decline the config expansion
options.body: Keep current global/channel/account debounce controls and ask for a new issue if per-conversation batching becomes a maintainer priority.

recommendation.title: Approve with docs and proof
recommendation.body: Accept the surface only after the contributor documents precedence and posts redacted real WhatsApp behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work in WhatsApp inbound policy, account scoping, and debounce close-drain makes this the strongest routing signal for the product/API choice.
